reason: Accept only the verified, non-grantable supabase_admin grants to PUBLIC that the project role cannot revoke. Clients and the executor have no unrestricted SQL or RPC path to these objects (met after the function privilege tightening in #189, #192, #196 and #201). Credential-bearing dispatch must avoid pg_net (OPEN, tracked by a follow-up due 2026-11-28). SQL-capable roles with schema access remain a residual risk.
